tokens.label: Concussion
tokens.description: A player afflicted with this token must skip their Income Phase and then remove this token.

tokens.label: Blind
tokens.description: The next time a player afflicted with this token activates an Offensive Ability, they must remove it and roll 1 die. On 1-2, their Offensive Ability fails to activate and has no effect of any kind. If a player concludes their Offensive Roll Phase without activating an Offensive Ability, remove this token.

tokens.label: Stun
tokens.description: A player afflicted with this token may take no actions of any kind (i.e. no cards may be played, no defense may be made, no status tokens or passive abilities may be used, etc). After the attack concludes, the player who inflicted Stun removes the token and then immediately targets the same opponent with an additional Offensive Roll Phase

tokens.label: Entangle
tokens.description: A player afflicted with this token gets 1 fewer Roll Attempts during their next Offensive Roll Phase. At the conclusion of the Roll Phase, remove this token.

tokens.label: Targeted
tokens.description: When a player afflicted with this token is Attacked by an opponent, the incoming Attack dmg is increased by 2. Attack Modifier. Persistent.

tokens.label: Evasive
tokens.description: When a player with this token has incoming damage (from any source), they may choose to spend it. If spent, roll 1 die. If the outcome is 1-2, no dmg is received (although other associated effects may still apply). Multiple tokens may be spent in an attempt to prevent the same source of damage.

tokens.label: Burn
tokens.description: A player afflicted with this token is dealt 2 dmg during their Upkeep Phase. Persistent.

tokens.label: Knockdown
tokens.description: To remove this token, a player afflicted with it must pay 2 CP before the start of their Offensive Roll Phase. If the player does not, they must skip their Offensive Roll Phase and then remove this token.

tokens.label: Shadows
tokens.description: When a player with this token is damaged as a result of an opponent’s Offensive Roll Phase, no damage is received and no defense is made (although the attack still “succeeds” & other effects may apply). Discard this token after the affected player starts & concludes a single turn while under its effects.

tokens.label: Sneak Attack
tokens.description: After Attacking, a player with this token may spend it and roll 1 die to add the value of the die to their damage total. Attack Modifier.

tokens.label: Poison
tokens.description: A player afflicted with this token is dealt 1 dmg per Poison token during the Upkeep Phase of their turn. Persistent.

tokens.label: Cleanse
tokens.description: A player with this token may spend it at any time to remove a single status effect from themselves.

tokens.label: Accuracy
tokens.description: A player with this token may spend it at the conclusion of their Offensive Roll Phase to make their Attack undefendable.

tokens.label: Blessing of Divinity
tokens.description: The next time a player (or team) with this token would have their health reduced to 0, remove this token and set their health to 1 instead. This token may not be removed or transferred by any other means.

tokens.label: Crit
tokens.description: If a player with this token is dealing at least dmg as a result of their Offensive Roll Phase, this token may be spent to add 4 dmg. Attack Modifier.

tokens.label: Protect
tokens.description: A player with this token may spend it at any time to prevent ½ incoming damage (rounded up).

tokens.label: Retribution
tokens.description: This token may be spent after being Attacked as a result of an opponent’s Offensive Roll Phase to deal half of the incoming dmg (rounded up) back to the attacker.

tokens.label: Delayed Poison
tokens.description: A player inflicted with this token removes it at the conclusion of their turn and then receives 3 dmg.

tokens.label: Ninjitsu
tokens.description: After Attacking, a player with this token may spend it and roll 1 die: • On 1-3, add 1 dmg. • On 4-5, add 2 dmg. • On 6, choose to either add 2 dmg, inflict Delayed Poison, or make your Attack undefendable. Attack Modifier.

tokens.label: Smoke Bomb
tokens.description: When a player with this token receives dmg, they may choose to spend it. If spent, roll 1 die. If the outcome is 1-3, no dmg is received (although other associated effects may still apply).

tokens.label: Barbed Vine
tokens.description: A player afflicted with this token receives 1 dmg for each Roll Attempt beyond the first during their Offensive Roll Phase, up to a maximum of 2 dmg per turn. This token is removed and then the dmg is applied at the conclusion of the Roll Phase.

tokens.label: Wellspring
tokens.description: A player with this token may spend it during their Main Phase & roll 1 die: gain ½ the value as Health (rounded up).

tokens.label: Reload
tokens.description: If a player concludes their Offensive Roll Phase with an Attack, they may spend this token. If spent, roll 1 die and add ½ the value as dmg (rounded up). Attack Modifier.

tokens.label: Back Strike
tokens.description: When a player with Back Strike has incoming damage as a result of an opponent’s Offensive Roll Phase, they may choose to spend this token. If spent, roll 1 die. Then deal ½ the value as dmg (rounded up) to that opponent.

tokens.label: Honor
tokens.description: Spend to increase your Attack dmg by 1, or spend 2 Honor to increase your Attack dmg by 3. Attack Modifier.

tokens.label: Shame
tokens.description: When player afflicted with Shame concludes their Offensive Roll Phase with an Attack, remove this token and reduce that Attack dmg by 1. Attack Modifier.

tokens.label: Bleed
tokens.description: A player afflicted with this token must roll 1 die during their Upkeep Phase. On 1-4, they are dealt 1 dmg. On 5-6, remove this token.

tokens.label: Constrict
tokens.description: During their next Offensive Roll Phase, a player afflicted with this token must pay 1 CP for each Roll Attempt beyond the first. At the conclusion of the Roll Phase, remove this token.

tokens.label: Cursed Doubloon
tokens.description: • Any player other than the Pirate afflicted with Cursed Doubloons is dealt 1 dmg per Cursed Doubloon during their Upkeep Phase. • Whenever the Pirate would gain a Cursed Doubloon, she may choose not to. • Cursed Doubloon tokens may stack up to 5x on the Pirate and up to 3x on anyone else.

tokens.label: Powder Keg
tokens.description: A player inflicted with this token must roll 1 die during their Upkeep Phase. On 1-2, the Keg blows up. On 3-5, nothing happens. On 6, the player afflicted with Powder Keg may transfer the token to a chosen player. Additionally, if a player becomes inflicted with Powder Keg while already inflicted with Powder Keg, the first Keg immediately blows up. When a Keg blows up, remove it and deal 3 dmg as an isolated source of undefendable dmg.

tokens.label: Parlay
tokens.description: A player afflicted with Parlay may not deal any dmg as a result of their Offensive Roll Phase (although other effects may still apply). At the conclusion of the Roll Phase, remove this token.

tokens.label: Wither
tokens.description: If a player with a Wither token would deal damage as a result of an Attack, reduce that dmg by 1 per Wither token. Attack Modifier. Persistent.

tokens.label: Nanite
tokens.description: When Detonated, remove all tokens and deal dmg based on the number of Nanites on each player: • 1 Nanite: receive 1 dmg. • 2 Nanites: receive 3 dmg. • 3 Nanites: receive 5 dmg. During Upkeep Phase, a player rolls 1 die per Nanite they are afflicted with: on 6, remove this token.

tokens.label: Blinding Light
tokens.description: The next time a player afflicted with this token activates an Offensive Ability, they must remove this token and roll 1 die: On 1, their Offensive Ability fails to activate and has no effect of any kind. On 2-3, any dmg they would deal for the remainder of the Roll Phase is reduced by ½ (rounded up).

tokens.label: Flight
tokens.description: A player with this token may spend it at any time during the Roll Phase. Once spent, roll 2 dice. If a 6 was rolled, Activate this token. If Activated during the Offensive Roll Phase, this player’s Attack becomes undefendable. If Activated during the Defensive Roll Phase, ignore all incoming damage.

tokens.label: Holy Presence
tokens.description: During their Upkeep Phase, a player with this token deals 1 dmg to all opponents. This token may not be transferred by any means (but can be removed).

tokens.label: Mesmerize
tokens.description: A player with this token may spend it and roll 1 die. On 5-6, you may force the opponent to reroll any one die.

tokens.label: Cheer
tokens.description: A player with this token may: Spend 1 to re-roll 1 of their dice. Spend 3 to change any one of their dice to a 6.

tokens.label: Coal
tokens.description: The next time a player with four of these tokens would gain CP, they must first remove all Coal tokens. Then reduce the amount of CP gained by 1.

tokens.label: Gift
tokens.description: During your Main Phase, you may spend this token to draw a card from the Reject deck and put it into play. This token may not be transferred by any means (but can be removed).

tokens.label: Grim Pursuit
tokens.description: A player with this token may spend it to activate one of the following effects: - Perform an additional Roll Attempt during your Offensive Roll Phase. - After Attacking, roll 5 : add 1 × [horseshoe die icon] dmg. Attack Modifier. Each effect may only be activated once per turn.

tokens.label: Decrep-ify
tokens.description: During their next Offensive Roll Phase, a player afflicted with this token may only re-roll a maximum of 2 dice when performing any Roll Attempt after their first Roll Attempt. Additionally, reduce any Attack dmg by 1. Attack Modifier. At the conclusion of the Roll Phase, remove this token.

tokens.label: Prey
tokens.description: When a player afflicted with this token is Attacked by an opponent, the Attacker may roll 1 die. On 1, remove this token. On 2–5, the Attacker increases their dmg by 1. On 6, the Attacker increases their dmg by 2. Attack Modifier.

tokens.label: Hex
tokens.description: A player afflicted with this token must treat all of their die faces with a 6 as if those faces are completely blank instead. At the conclusion of their turn, remove this token. This token may not be transferred by any means (but can be removed).

tokens.label: Regenerate
tokens.description: When you gain this token, place it on the side up. During their Upkeep Phase, a player with this token does the following based on which side is face-up: • Regenerate : Heal 2 and flip it to the side. • Regenerate : Heal 1 and remove this token. Additionally, if a player gains Regenerate while at Stack Limit, they may flip a [1 token] to the [2 token] side instead.

tokens.label: Wound
tokens.description: A player afflicted with this token is dealt 1 dmg during their Upkeep Phase. Then roll 1 die: on 4-6, remove this token.

tokens.label: Disarm
tokens.description: During their Upkeep Phase, a player afflicted with this token may choose to discard 1 card . If they do not (or cannot), they must skip their Income Phase instead. Then remove this token.

tokens.label: Guard Break
tokens.description: If a player concludes their Offensive Roll Phase with an Attack, they may spend this token and roll 1 die. If the outcome is 4-5, the Attack becomes undefendable

tokens.label: Charged Gem
tokens.description: A player with this token may spend it during their Main Phase and roll 1 die: • On 1-2, gain 1CP. • On 3-4, deal 2 as an isolated source of undefendable dmg to a chosen opponent. • On 5-6, gain 1CP and deal 2 as an isolated source of undefendable dmg to a chosen opponent.

tokens.label: Sun-Marked
tokens.description: When a player afflicted with this token is Attacked by an opponent, the Attacker Heals 2. Attack Modifier. Persistent.

tokens.label: Cosmic flare
tokens.description: During their Upkeep Phase, a player with this token deals 1 dmg per Cosmic Flare Cosmic Flare to all opponents. Then remove 1 of these tokens.

tokens.label: Radiance
tokens.description: A player with this token may spend it to change the value of any die rolled as a part of the Roll Attempt during their Defensive Roll Phase to a 6.

tokens.label: Agility
tokens.description: When a player with this token receives damage, they may spend it and roll 1 . If the outcome is 1–3, prevent 1/2 incoming damage (rounded up).

tokens.label: Time bomb
tokens.description:
When inflicting this token, if you have at least 6 Ability Upgrades in play, place it on the Time Bomb 1 side up. Otherwise, place it on the Time Bomb 2 side up.
During their Upkeep Phase, a player afflicted with this token must roll 1 :
On 1–5, advance the Time Bomb Time Bomb 2.
On 6, remove the token.
When a Time Bomb Time Bomb 2 is advanced:
If the token is on the Time Bomb 2 side, flip it to the Time Bomb 1 side.
If the token is on the Time Bomb 1 side, the player afflicted with this token removes it and receives  dmg as an isolated source of undefendable dmg.

tokens.label: Déjà vue
tokens.description: Instead of activating an Ability, a player with this token may spend it to conclude their current Offensive Roll Phase and then start a new Offensive Roll Phase.

tokens.label: Premonition
tokens.description:
A player with these tokens may spend them once per turn during their Income Phase to activate one of the following effects:
1 token: draw 2 instead of 1.
3 tokens: draw 3 instead of 1.
When activated, one of the drawn cards must be placed on either the top or bottom of the deck.

tokens.label: Crimson bands
tokens.description: A player afflicted with this token cannot play cards during their next Roll Phase. Then, at the conclusion of that Roll Phase, remove this token.

tokens.label: Probability Manipulation
tokens.description: Spend to change the value of any of your dice displaying an even number (2, 4, 6), up or down by a value of 1 (a value of 6 cannot be increased).

tokens.label: Reality Warp
tokens.description: If a player is inflicted with this token when they begin their Offensive Roll Phase, they must remove it and use one of Scarlet Witch’s dice in place of one of their own until the end of the Offensive Roll Phase.

tokens.label: Conjure
tokens.description:
Once per turn, a player with this token may spend it during their Main Phase to either:
Gain a Positive Status Effect from a chosen player’s leaflet. Any opponent may prevent this by discarding  1 of their choice.
Inflict Reality Warp Reality Warp on a chosen opponent.

tokens.label: Crackle
tokens.description: If a player concludes their Offensive Roll Phase with an Attack, they may spend this token. If spent, add 1 dmg per Positive or Negative Status Effect on their Hero Board (excluding the Crackle Crackle that was just spent), up to a maximum of 3. Only two Crackle Crackle may be spent per turn. Attack Modifier.

tokens.label: Bag of Tricks
tokens.description:
During their Upkeep Phase, a player with this token removes it and rolls 1 :
On 1, lose .
On 2–5, Loki chooses whether the player heals 2 , gains 1CP, or receives  2  undefendable dmg.
On 6, gain 2CP .

tokens.label: Webbed
tokens.description:
When this token is inflicted deal  2 as an isolated source of undefendable dmg.
The next time a player afflicted with this token is Attacked with normal damage, the damage type becomes undefendable instead and this token is immediately removed.

tokens.label: Electrokinesis
tokens.description: Once per turn, a player may spend 4 Electrokinesis  during their Main Phase to draw 1 card .

tokens.label: Battle plan
tokens.description:
A player with these tokens may spend them to activate each effect once per turn:
1 token: Examine a chosen opponent’s hand.
3 tokens: Look at the top three cards of your deck. If any of them are Leadership Cards, you may reveal one of them to your opponent and add it to your hand. Each remaining card may be discarded or put back in any order.
3 tokens: Inflict Focus Fire  on a chosen opponent.

tokens.label: Support
tokens.description:
Spend these tokens for a variety of effects:
1 token: A chosen player gains 1CP.
1 token: A chosen player may re-roll 1 of their dice at any time.
3 tokens: A chosen player may draw 1 card .

tokens.label: Focus Fire
tokens.description: When a player with this token is Attacked by an opponent, the Attacker increases their damage by 1. Attack Modifier. Persistent.

tokens.label: Dissolution
tokens.description: A player with this token may spend it during their Main Phase. When spent, choose a player to Heal 2 or remove a Negative Status Effect from that player.

tokens.label: Disruption
tokens.description: During their Upkeep Phase, a player afflicted with this token may choose to lose 1CP . If they do not (or cannot), they receive 2 undefendable dmg instead. Then remove this token.

tokens.label: Dice cube
tokens.description:
A player afflicted with this token cannot alter the lowest value die from their first Roll Attempt during their Offensive Roll Phase. If at Stack Limit, this affects the two lowest value dice rolled (instead of one).
At the conclusion of the Roll Phase, remove these tokens (even if an Ability wasn’t activated successfully).

tokens.label: Force Field
tokens.description: Remove this token and one other Positive Status Effect on your Hero Board, then choose a player to prevent  incoming damage (rounded up).

tokens.label: Acuity
tokens.description:
1 token: Re-roll 1 of your dice at any time.
2 tokens: Gain 1 CP .
4 tokens: Inflict Phoenix Burn Phoenix Burn on a chosen opponent.

tokens.label: Flame blast
tokens.description: If Dark Phoenix is Active, she may spend Flame Blast to increase her Attack dmg by  1 or spend 3 Flame Blast to increase her Attack dmg by 4. Attack Modifier.

tokens.label: Phoenix burn
tokens.description: A player afflicted with this token is dealt 2  undefendable dmg during their Upkeep Phase. Then roll 1 dice : on 5–6, remove this token.

tokens.label: Paralyse
tokens.description:
A player afflicted with this token cannot gain or inflict any status effects associated with any of their Offensive Abilities (all other effects of the ability still apply).
When a player with this token concludes their Roll Phase, remove it.

tokens.label: Infiltration
tokens.description: A player with this token may spend it and then choose a die rolled by any player (including themselves) during their Defensive Roll Attempt. The chosen die must be re-rolled.

tokens.label: Influence
tokens.description: A player afflicted with these tokens must roll 1 Dice  at the start of their Offensive Roll Phase per token. For every 1–3 rolled, they get one fewer Roll Attempt. Then remove all of these tokens.

tokens.label: Ionic Energy
tokens.description:
A player with this token may choose to spend it to add the indicated number of damage to their Attack.
You may only spend up to 2 tokens per turn.
Alternatively, pay 1CP to spend up to 4 tokens this turn.
Attack Modifier.

tokens.label: Skyward
tokens.description:
When a player with this token is Attacked, they may choose to spend it. If spent, you and your Attacker each roll 1Dice . 
The player who spent this token may pay 1 CP to re-roll their die (may do this multiple times):
If your outcome is greater, deal 3  undefendable dmg back to the Attacker.
If your outcome is equal, prevent  4incoming dmg.

tokens.label: Tornado
tokens.description: A player with this token may spend it at the start of their Offensive Roll Phase. For each token spent, gain an opponent’s die. These dice may be included in all Roll Attempts during this Offensive Roll Phase.

tokens.label: Wind shear
tokens.description:
A player with this token may spend it when being Attacked to prevent 2 incoming dmg.
Then choose an opponent to receive 2 as an isolated source of undefendable dmg.

tokens.label: Rage
tokens.description:
A player with this token may:
Spend 1 and discard 1  to add 3 dmg to their Attack. Attack Modifier.
Spend 3 to draw 1 .

tokens.label: Chaos
tokens.description: Chaos token.

tokens.label: Main du roi
tokens.description: Special support token.

tokens.label: First Strike
tokens.description: This unit starts first.

tokens.label: Salve
tokens.description: Spend to gain 6 health.

tokens.label: Silence
tokens.description: Silence token.

tokens.label: Hoarding
tokens.description: Hero loses 1 die during the next battle phase.

tokens.label: Dégat Bonus 1
tokens.description: Bonus damage token (+1 attack).

tokens.label: Dégat Bonus 2
tokens.description: Bonus damage token (+2 attack).

tokens.label: Dégat Bonus 3
tokens.description: Bonus damage token (+3 attack).

tokens.label: Dégat Bonus 4
tokens.description: Bonus damage token (+4 attack).

tokens.label: Domination
tokens.description: Domination token.

tokens.label: Parasite
tokens.description: Parasite token.

tokens.label: Prime
tokens.description: Bounty token.

tokens.label: Siphon vital
tokens.description: Life siphon token.

tokens.label: Sort 6
tokens.description: Spellbound token.

tokens.label: Forme Ours
tokens.description: Dark Druid bear form.

tokens.label: Forme Elan
tokens.description: Dark Druid elk form.
